question: Describe a time you worked in a team and faced a conflict. How did you resolve it?
description: Assesses teamwork and conflict resolution skills.
purposeOfQuestion: Interviewer evaluates interpersonal skills and conflict management approach.
exampleAnswer: In my previous project, two team members disagreed on the database design approach. One wanted a NoSQL solution; the other preferred relational. Situation: we were behind schedule. I proposed a structured discussion where each presented pros/cons against our actual use cases. We agreed on a hybrid approach. Result: we delivered on time and the solution handled 40% more concurrent users than projected.
evaluationCriteria: Diplomacy, structured approach, focus on resolution, measurable outcome
followUpQuestions: What would you do if the conflict escalated?
How do you prevent conflicts in teams?
What did you learn from this experience?
